The tank shows signs of wear, dirt, and possible scuffing on the surface.
The tank is standing on a concrete or paved ground, with other similar tanks visible in the background.
No brand or model name is visible on the tank in either photo.
The seller claims it is a 'Geepee tank 4000ltrs'.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
